instruction: Look at hard-04_seed.dxf. Before starting the work, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-04_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'hydraulic manifold block with cross-drilled channels' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CHANNEL, CUTOUT, OUTLINE, PORT, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(240,0); OUTLINE (240,0)->(240,90); OUTLINE (240,90)->(0,90); OUTLINE (0,90)->(0,0); CENTER (30,0)->(30,90); CENTER (70,0)->(70,90); CENTER (110,0)->(110,90); CENTER (150,0)->(150,90); CENTER (190,0)->(190,90); CENTER (225,0)->(225,90); CENTER (0,20)->(240,20); CENTER (0,45)->(240,45); CENTER (0,70)->(240,70); CHANNEL (30,20)->(225,20); CHANNEL (30,45)->(225,45); CHANNEL (30,70)->(225,70); CHANNEL (70,20)->(70,70); CHANNEL (150,20)->(150,70); CHANNEL (190,20)->(190,70); CUTOUT (100,24)->(140,24); CUTOUT (100,16)->(140,16); CUTOUT (100,74)->(140,74); CUTOUT (100,66)->(140,66). Required circles: PORT center (30,45) radius 10; PORT center (70,45) radius 8; PORT center (110,45) radius 12; PORT center (150,45) radius 8; PORT center (190,45) radius 10; PORT center (225,45) radius 6; PORT center (60,20) radius 5; PORT center (180,70) radius 5. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (100,20) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (140,20) radius 4 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (100,70) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (140,70) radius 4 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H04; ANNOTATION text P1 P2 P3 T A B. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
